correctness.rationale: Every one of 4^7 indegree assignments is tested; 10647 nonempty faces enumerated. Exactly 5067 face-coface pairs and 1 vertex plus 512 dimension-five critical simplices result. Topological sorting all 50799 Hasse incidences certifies acyclicity; exact Laplacian cofactor 392 independently checks top-face count. Lefschetz signed fixed simplices check all 21 affine maps and give character (512,1,-1). Explicit rational irreducible character equations uniquely yield 24,25,73. The full standalone verifier executes with VERIFY_OK.

originality.rationale: Direct full-text statement/implication comparisons with Kozlov 2002, Engström 2005 and Jojić 2011 show different graph hypotheses; published acyclic-subgraph, tournament flag and neighborhood complexes have different face conditions. Closest accessible own earlier work is DT of a two-generator S3 Cayley digraph, neither the Paley seven-vertex tournament nor its affine character. A directly relevant 2020 Cayley-complex thesis and original Kozlov 1999 paper were inaccessible in full; this leaves material residual novelty risk but no positive evidence of covering implication.

value.rationale: Canonical smallest doubly regular tournament lies outside complete-source and DAG shellability examples. Exact integral homotopy and full rational F21 representation provide a natural nontrivial classification beyond an f-vector, with 24 invariant top-homology directions; it offers a concrete reproducible case for directed-forest and equivariant methods, without claiming generality or a paper-scale theorem.
